//: Upstream releases the seeded catalog is held back from. `broken` lists the releases that fail, `hold` is the version pinned in their place, and `why` says what fails. template/base/pnpm-workspace.yaml is seeded, so `update` cannot move an existing install's range off a broken release: the project pins it by hand, and scripts/ci/apply-catalog-holds.mjs makes the same edit for the upgrade lane, whose legs install earlier releases with their own ranges. A hold applies only where a scaffold's range admits a broken release. Remove a row once a release that fixes the fault is pinned in the seeded catalog.

holds.name: typescript-eslint
holds.why: 8.73.0 adds no-unsafe-class-instance-assignment to strictTypeChecked, and the rule overflows the stack on a recursive conditional type such as react-native's animated style props, so `lint` crashes on apps/mobile's PressableScale.tsx

holds.name: expo-sqlite
holds.why: 57.0.5's prebuilt Android library carries libexpo-sqlite.so for arm64-v8a only (expo/expo#53673), so on an x86_64 emulator or a 32-bit device the kv store cannot load and every key reads as absent
